Anthropic says AI is becoming too powerful and may need to be slowed down. But the timing has raised serious questions.

Just days after reaching a $1 trillion valuation and announcing plans to go public, the company released a report warning that AI could soon improve itself with minimal human involvement. Their proposed solution is a coordinated slowdown across the industry. Critics argue that such a move wouldn't just improve safety, it could also freeze competitors in place and make it far harder for open-source projects to catch up.

Anthropic already relies heavily on AI-generated code, while researchers warn that AI systems are becoming capable of handling increasingly complex tasks with less human oversight. At the same time, a growing battle is emerging between companies calling for stricter regulation and those who believe new rules could cement the dominance of today's AI giants.
